purpose: Observed natural RNG branches and default-APL continuations; mechanism/APL evidence, not global optimality or identical-state counterfactuals.

sourceRefs: Main and Dawn share base damage impact: each primary-target crit adjusts FoF.
Dawn proc roll uses composite melee haste and executes a separate damage action.
SCK ground-effect expiration reduces FoF by distinct target count, subject to cap.
WDP triggers ordinary Heart of the Jade Serpent.
Zenith triggers its Jade window and resets RSK.
Unity Within expiration triggers Great Jade.
FoF adjustment is scaled by recharge rate; ready cooldown returns without logging; reset sentinel is not a duration.
Dynamic recovery multiplier changes rescale remaining cooldown.
Explicit nonzero seed initializes RNG; deterministic=0 avoids iteration reseed.
debug enables log; log forces a single iteration and thread.
Foreground action sequence is captured after queueing, before execution.
Full states capture only cooldowns that are down.

settings.apl: Pinned engine default; no actions override.

limitations: All log lines are one-based in the referenced original full 300-second log. Timestamps are logged at millisecond precision.
Action-sequence snapshots describe selection/queue time. These first-RSK selection times match execution to log precision; later coreCasts always use actual performs Action lines.
reportedCoreCooldownRemains null means omitted/not directly reported. Full-state reports omit ready cooldowns and cannot supply exact charge state from absence.
observedAfterSeconds null is not an observed zero. No-crit has no immediate post-hit FoF readout; AoE reset logs contain -3600 ready sentinels, not physical negative cooldowns.
Seeds share configuration and selected core opener, not identical RNG state, buffs, energy, cooldown or offsets. Equipment, potion and other passive procs remain enabled.
Baseline haste is 19%; momentum, temporary haste procs and Bloodlust can change effective in-combat haste. Recovery buffs also rescale FoF independently.
Compatibility ilevel=341 overrides and historical redirected_base_stats/crafted_stats are preserved assumptions, not new live-client item-stat measurements.
optimal_raid=0 differs from the trainer calibration raid-buff context; no damage or whole-model parity is claimed.
Battle Gi of the Monkey King and Band of the Swarmcaller emit engine implementation-not-yet-verified damage-splitting notices.
Single-iteration samples establish possible observed behavior and default-APL continuations, not branch probabilities, DPS ranking or live-client correctness.
